mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate an aggressive monetary tightening cycle to combat rising prices, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over the next 20 days, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing and supply chain activity contraction signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and demand for housing, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises month-over-month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 720,000 (thousands of dollars) signals a contraction in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS falls below 720,000, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate a dual stress of labor market weakness and aggressive monetary tightening, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in UNRATE and FEDFUNDS does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over the next 20 days, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) and active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced real yields and equity risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
